body:
burrow new <name> now generates real MODULE.bazel/BUILD.bazel pinning a real @burrow commit, live-verified via bazel run against a fresh scaffold (fetched @burrow from GitHub, compiled .prn via genrule, ran correctly). Also found and fixed a real, pre-existing bug: a fresh clone of BURROW itself failed to build (lo_lexer.go/lo_parser.go/lo_parser_test.go/unparse.go were never committed, though main.go already referenced them). go test 101/101. Commits 977dd9e, bb5e4c5.

⚓ ☃
title: burrow new generates real Bazel files by default (kanban PX-333) + fixed a broken fresh-clone build
